# SignatureCat

> SignatureCat (https://signature.cat) centrally manages Gmail signatures across a Google Workspace: one HTML template with variables, assigned to users, groups, organizational units or the whole workspace, applied and kept up to date automatically. EU-hosted, GDPR-ready. The app runs at https://app.signature.cat.

Full documentation content in one file: https://signature.cat/llms-full.txt

## Getting started

- [Introduction](https://signature.cat/docs): What SignatureCat is and how it manages Gmail signatures across your Google Workspace - templates, assignments and automatic daily sync.
- [Connect your Google Workspace](https://signature.cat/docs/connect-google-workspace): Register SignatureCat as a Google Workspace super admin, provision your isolated service account and authorize Domain-Wide Delegation.
- [Create your first template](https://signature.cat/docs/create-your-first-template): Create a Gmail signature template in SignatureCat, personalize it with Google Directory variables, preview it and test it on your own mailbox.
- [Assign templates to groups, OUs or everyone](https://signature.cat/docs/assign-templates): Bind SignatureCat templates to Google groups, organizational units or every active user in the Workspace, and sync signatures on demand.
- [Verify an assignment job](https://signature.cat/docs/verify-assignments): Check that a SignatureCat signature job succeeded in Google Workspace - job statuses, per-user results, error codes and reading a live Gmail mailbox.

## Advanced setup

- [User management and access levels](https://signature.cat/docs/user-management): Who can sign in to SignatureCat, what each Google Workspace access level allows, and who may edit signature data or grant access to groups.
- [Self-service signatures](https://signature.cat/docs/self-service): Let end users pick and apply their own Gmail signature from admin-approved SignatureCat templates - setup, flow, own data and precedence rules.
- [User data overrides](https://signature.cat/docs/user-data): Store per-user values that override your Google Workspace directory in Gmail signatures - consent, the nine fields, self-service editing and deletion.
- [Import user data from a CSV](https://signature.cat/docs/user-data-import): Bulk-load per-user signature data into SignatureCat from a CSV file - columns, replace rules, limits, the preview step and the Gmail sync afterwards.
- [Serve images from your own domain](https://signature.cat/docs/custom-image-domain): Point a subdomain like images.yourcompany.com at SignatureCat with one CNAME record so signature images in Gmail load from your own domain.
- [Upload and insert banners and logos](https://signature.cat/docs/banners-and-logos): Add company logos and campaign banners to Gmail signature templates in SignatureCat - image library, ALT descriptions, sizes, click links and deletion.

## Billing

- [Invoices](https://signature.cat/docs/invoices): How SignatureCat billing works - pricing tiers, the 7-day trial, where invoices are sent and how to set a dedicated invoice email.
- [Change billing info and payment details](https://signature.cat/docs/billing-details): Update your card, company name, billing address and tax ID for SignatureCat invoices through the Stripe billing portal.

## Reference

- [Domain-Wide Delegation](https://signature.cat/docs/domain-wide-delegation): How SignatureCat uses Google Domain-Wide Delegation - scopes, the per-tenant client ID, propagation, revocation detection and re-granting.
- [Templates](https://signature.cat/docs/templates): How SignatureCat signature templates work - the visual and HTML editors, live preview, test apply to Gmail, the default template and safe deletion.
- [Visual editor](https://signature.cat/docs/visual-editor): Design Gmail signature templates without writing HTML - variable chips, columns, dividers, custom images and email-safe formatting on one canvas.
- [Mail client preview](https://signature.cat/docs/mail-client-preview): See a Gmail signature on simulated Gmail, Outlook and Apple Mail surfaces in light and dark - what the SignatureCat preview shows and what it cannot.
- [Template variables](https://signature.cat/docs/template-variables): Every SignatureCat signature variable - Google Workspace directory fields, per-user data overrides, logo and banner tokens and del/delete conditional blocks.
- [Assignments](https://signature.cat/docs/assignments): SignatureCat assignments reference - target kinds, precedence when a user matches several assignments, alias modes and conflict handling.
- [Apply jobs](https://signature.cat/docs/apply-jobs): How SignatureCat writes Gmail signatures across Google Workspace - the daily assignment sync, one-shot applies from the Apply page and job tracking.
- [Logs](https://signature.cat/docs/logs): Where SignatureCat records every Gmail signature job - task logs, per-user results, the trimmed by Gmail badge, live mailbox checks and retention.
- [Images](https://signature.cat/docs/images): Reference for images in SignatureCat email signatures for Google Workspace - the library, ALT descriptions, hosting, formats, limits and deletion.
- [Notifications](https://signature.cat/docs/notifications): Which SignatureCat signature alerts arrive by email and which appear in the app - Google Workspace access, assignment targets, images, billing.

## Support

- [Support access](https://signature.cat/docs/support-access): What SignatureCat support can and cannot do on your Google Workspace account, including viewing a user's current Gmail signature, and how it is logged.
- [Get help](https://signature.cat/docs/get-help): How to reach SignatureCat support about Gmail signature problems - what to check first in status, logs and Google Workspace access, and what to include.
- [When Gmail trims your signature](https://signature.cat/docs/gmail-sanitization): Why Gmail can store a trimmed copy of a signature SignatureCat applied in your Google Workspace, how to spot it and how to fix the template.
- [Service status and SLA](https://signature.cat/docs/service-status): SignatureCat live status page, the 99% monthly availability target, what counts as downtime and where maintenance windows are announced.
- [Legal](https://signature.cat/docs/legal): SignatureCat legal documents - Terms of Service, Privacy Policy and DPA - plus what the app reads from Google Workspace and writes as a Gmail signature.
